Question: Detect Cycle in an Undirected Graph

You are given an undirected graph with:

N vertices numbered from 1 to N

M edges

Determine whether the graph contains a cycle.

If there is at least one cycle, print:

Cycle Detected

Otherwise print:

No Cycle

🔹 Input Format
N M
u1 v1
u2 v2
...
uM vM

🔹 Output Format

Print:

"Cycle Detected"
OR

"No Cycle"

🔹
input_spec:
N M
u1 v1
u2 v2
...
uM vM

🔹
constraints:
1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5

0 ≤ M ≤ 10^5

Graph is undirected

No self-loops
